name: Stavros S. Anthony
summary: Stavros Steve Anthony (born January 13, 1957) is an American politician and retired law enforcement officer who is the 37th lieutenant governor of Nevada, since 2023. A member of the Republican Party, Anthony won the 2022 Nevada lieutenant governor election, defeating incumbent Democrat Lisa Cano Burkhead. He lost re-election in 2026 to Democrat Sandra Jauregui.
